note.question: Should a paid Q&A platform monetize existing answers through a low-priced viewing feature, and how will that feature change platform fees, expert prices, profits, and user surplus?
note.overview: A Q&A platform chooses commission and answer-viewing fees, two differentiated answerers simultaneously choose personalized-consulting prices, and users choose personalized questions, nonpersonalized viewing, or exit. The model is solved as a multistage game in subgame-perfect equilibrium.
